description: This file defines the LDAPUser class used for LDAP user data transfer, encapsulating LDAP user attributes and related methods for validation, setting, and retrieving LDAP user information within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

classes.name: LDAPUser
classes.description: Represents an LDAP user, providing attributes and methods for LDAP data validation and encapsulation, including setting user details, applying length constraints, and handling LDAP entry data.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name (DN) for the LDAP user, throwing an exception if it exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for the LDAP user, validating its length against minimum and maximum constraints.

methods.name: getUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LDAP user, if set.

methods.name: setUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for the LDAP user and warns if it exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: isUserEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the LDAP user is enabled.

methods.name: setUserEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the LDAP user, validating length.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name, validating its length.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name with length validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID if set.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID, validating its length.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email if set.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email with length check and email format validation.

methods.name: setUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Assigns LDAP user lookup settings.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Assigns the LDAP entry object to this user.

methods.name: getEmployeeSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Returns search filter parameters based on LDAP entry and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLogInfo
methods.description: Provides information for logging, including DN and attributes.
